findings.text: The cache configuration retains a fallback to the replaced `nix-tests-v1` scheme. Fix: remove the v1 restore prefix.
The `flake_input_paths` docstring describes its result without explaining its purpose. Fix: explain that these paths become roots so garbage collection preserves the flake inputs.

A command timeout bypasses the failure handler, hiding captured diagnostics and recovery guidance. Fix: handle `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` and report the failed command, captured diagnostic, and next action.
The scope table says main pushes run `just package`, but documentation-only main pushes select `docs`. Fix: document this exception in the table.
